rationale.edition: Classified 'both'. The diff's changed paths span enterprise-owned locations (o2_enterprise/src/enterprise/announcements/meta.rs, mod.rs, and o2_enterprise/src/enterprise/mod.rs) alongside OSS paths (src/handler/http/request/announcements/, src/common/utils/auth.rs, and the whole web/src/ UI layer). The enterprise crate holds the storage/normalization/resolution logic; OSS carries the HTTP handler scaffolding (empty/forbidden without the enterprise feature) plus the full frontend. Per spec, a combined OSS+ENT sister pair is 'both', and edition never triggers a skip.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. No explicit opt-out exists (feature_hint.txt and trigger_comment.txt are both empty; no tests-added label was passed). The change is clearly user-facing: it adds a live announcement strip to MainLayout and a full authoring surface under Settings > General.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. A new user-exercisable UI flow exists on both sides: an operator authors a banner (Add/Edit dialog with severity, schedule, dismissibility, CTA and org targeting; Publish), and every org member sees it rendered at the top of the app with dismiss and CTA interactions. These are behaviors only a browser-level test can verify end-to-end.
rationale.area: Area is GeneralTests. The feature is a global/settings concern rather than a Logs/Metrics/Traces/etc. signal feature; the entry point is the General settings page and the live bar lives in the shared MainLayout. Sibling global/settings specs (theme-management, logoManagement, cipherKeys, languageTranslation, ingestion-config, landingPage) already live in the GeneralTests folder.
rationale.group: playwright_group is 'GeneralTests'. It is the closest existing matrix shard — it already holds the settings/global UI specs (logoManagement, cipherKeys, theme-management, languageTranslation) and the workflow maps it to the playwright-tests/GeneralTests directory without an alias.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The only test files added are Vitest unit specs (web/src/components/settings/*.spec.ts, web/src/composables/useAnnouncementBanners.spec.ts, web/src/utils/announcementOrder.spec.ts) — these are unit coverage, not Playwright E2E specs under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/, so they do not set existing_tests_in_diff and are not E2E coverage of the new feature.
